_about: David Binning Monro (1836-1905), Provost of Oriel. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics): The Modes of Ancient Greek Music, clean Gutenberg. No uids minted. A Grammar of the Homeric Dialect, second edition (Clarendon Press, 1891), and Homer's Odyssey, Books XIII-XXIV, edited with English notes and appendices (Clarendon Press, MDCCCCI), Greek text with English commentary, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling; raw IA. Round dy (2026-10-23), raw IA: his school Iliad, Book I with the essay on Homeric grammar (1878) and the two-volume Iliad (Books I-XII, fourth edition 1894; Books XIII-XXIV, fourth edition 1897), taken in those dated issues rather than the 1928-29 Oxford impressions.
